title: Closed base change preserves completed Jacobian torsion
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $P=\widehat{A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]}_I$ for $r\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $J\subseteq P$ be an ideal and put $E=P/J$, assumed $I$-adically complete. Suppose some $c\geq0$ satisfies $I^c\ker\delta=I^c\operatorname{coker}\delta=0$, where $\delta:J/J^2\to E^{\oplus r}$ sends $f\bmod J^2$ to $(\partial f/\partial x_i\bmod J)_i$, using continuous polynomial derivatives. Let $H\subseteq A$ be any ideal, put $A_0=A/H$, and let $K\subseteq A_0$ be an ideal with $V(IA_0)=V(K)$ in $\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $E_0=E/HE$ is $K$-adically complete and admits an $A_0$-algebra presentation $E_0\cong\widehat{A_0[y_1,\ldots,y_s]}_K/J_0$ for some finite $s\geq0$ and ideal $J_0$. For this presentation there is an integer $d\geq0$ such that $K^d$ annihilates both kernel and cokernel of the continuous conormal differential $J_0/J_0^2\to E_0^{\oplus s}$, $f\mapsto(\partial f/\partial y_j)_j$.
